method: JsonSerializer.Deserialize(input, type, JsonDefaults.Options), using the official portable Jellyfin.Extensions.dll
corrections: Quoted NaN, Infinity and -Infinity are accepted for float/double with AllowReadingFromString.
Overflow to infinity is accepted for bare float/double numbers but rejected for quoted numbers.
Numeric strings reject whitespace. Enum strings trim whitespace and accept comma-separated names even for non-flags enums.
Only the exact empty string is null for nullable structs; whitespace is rejected.
Nullable Guid uses its dedicated converter and rejects the empty string.
String members preserve raw numeric lexemes, keep null, and reject objects/arrays.
The flags converter throws NotImplementedException; MediaSourceInfo marks its two flags fields JsonIgnore.
